protocol.test_type: Unoptimised single-index reconstruction, not a stock-universe replication
protocol.range: 09:30 inclusive to 09:35 exclusive America/New_York, five completed M1 bid bars
protocol.relative_volume: Opening five-minute tick volume / arithmetic mean of previous 14 exchange sessions' opening five-minute tick volume
protocol.direction: Opening range candle close > open: buy stop at bid range high. Close < open: sell stop at bid range low. Equal: skip.
protocol.entry: First ask touch of buy stop or bid touch of sell stop after 09:35; adverse opening gap filled at current quote; maximum one trade per exchange session
protocol.atr: Arithmetic mean of true ranges of the previous 14 completed New York cash sessions, including overnight close-to-session gaps
protocol.stop: 0.10 times lagged daily ATR14, from execution price, rounded to 0.01 index point
protocol.exit: Stop or New York cash close (16:00 ET, 13:00 on official early-close days); no target, trailing, break-even or other filters
protocol.primary_execution: Conservative M1 OHLC: entry-bar high/low ordering ambiguous cases stop first. Bid bars + historical per-minute spread; stop gaps fill adversely.
protocol.ordering_sensitivity: Alternative feasible entry-bar ordering ignores pre-entry opposite extreme unless close breaches stop; otherwise identical
protocol.missing_spread: Zero/missing spread replaced only by last previously observed positive spread; no future backfill
protocol.sizing: Floor to 0.01 lot; 0.05 minimum, 500 maximum; $1/index point/lot from saved broker specification
protocol.commission: Zero explicit commission assumed. Additional 2.0 index-point round-trip execution-cost sensitivity also reported. No swaps for same-session trades.
protocol.data_quality: Skip sessions with incomplete opening range, missing prior-14-session inputs, cash-session gaps, or no quote within two minutes of the cash close. No data imputation for prices or volume.
protocol.not_included: Cross-sectional top-20 ranking, stock-specific liquidity filters, real tick sequencing, spread changes within a minute, latency, queue position, margin/liquidity/stop rejection modelling
protocol.note: Only the date window changed; retains previous 2x interpretation, not a 1x paper replication.
